title: The 10/10 profile guide.
description: A scored LinkedIn profile audit for founders and B2B execs: ten checks, one point each, with the rule, a fill-in template and a before and after for every one.
formHeader: Ten checks you can fix in 30 minutes.
formEyebrow: Get it free, in your inbox
disclosure: You will also get The Draft, one letter a week on how top 1% startups crush organic marketing. Leave whenever you like.

blocks.text: Everyone you message checks your profile before they reply, and most founder profiles lose that moment with a headline that just says "Co-founder" and nothing on the page about what the company does.
I'm a partner at RallyUp, where we write LinkedIn for B2B founders and executives, and this is the audit we run on a profile before we post a word.

items: A 10 point scorecard you can run on your profile in five minutes
The rule for each one: photo, banner, headline, About, Featured, Experience and your next step
Fill-in-the-brackets templates for headlines, banners and your About opening
A before and after for every check
The order to fix it in 30 minutes, and a one page checklist

blocks.text: The ten checks are my judgement from fixing founder profiles, and none of them will change your reach. What a better profile changes is how many of the people who land on it actually reply.
